steps.text: Bring a rope and a shovel.
steps.source: Required Equipment: Rope, Elvenhair Rope or Magic Rope spell; Shovel or Light Shovel

steps.text: Use the hollow stone close to the Desert Dungeon entrance: key 4055.
steps.source: To get the key, "use" the hollow stone (Mapper Coords 127.140, 125.108, 7). It's very close to the entrance to the dungeon.

steps.text: Go back to the Desert Dungeon entrance, use your shovel and go inside.
steps.source: Go back to the Desert Dungeon entrance, use your shovel, and go inside.

steps.text: Go down 4 more floors to the bottom (spiders).
steps.source: Take a Ladder down 5 times, to the bottom, you will face Spiders.

steps.text: Follow the way west and south and go up the ladder.
steps.source: Follow this path around to the west and south, possible meeting one Bonelord, and go up a level.

steps.text: Go north-west past the Desert Dungeon Library (spiders) and rope up the hole.
steps.source: Next, follow this path north-west (meeting a few Spiders again) past the Desert Dungeon Library, and rope up the hole.

steps.text: Follow the way south and go up one more level.
steps.source: On this level, follow this path south, and go up one more level.
Finally, follow this path to the south-east to the locked door.
Follow this path to the south-east to the locked door, one Fire Devil, and the quest box.

steps.text: The quest box: a power ring, panpipes and 2 small amethysts in a bag (the box isn't on the 7.1 map; this is its 7.6 spot).
steps.source: The quest box containing a Bag with 1 Power Ring, Panpipes and 2 Small Amethysts.
